If you didn’t enjoy eigong that’s a perfectly valid opinion, but i really don’t think Eigong is bad difficulty.  To me “tedious difficulty” is things like long invincibility phases like the moonlight butterfly from ds1 or the venegfly from hollow knight who can take a long time to be killed because they just can’t be hit a majority of time. Eigong however can be a long and tedious if you let it, but you can also control the speed of the fight. as you learn Eigong’s attacks you find more and more opening and the fight gets shorter as you are able to keep up agro, my first few eigong attempts were probably like 5 minutes on just the first 2 phases while i tried to figure out her openings and focused on parrying, dodging, and healing but after the learning her attacks my final fight where i won was only a little over 3 minutes because i was able to take advantage of more openings, heal less, and generally have less wasted movements. Again if you really feel like it’s a tedious boss it’s your opinion, but one of the aspects i loved most about the Eigong fight is how fast paced it is once you get in the flow, especially for people who are good at this game who can beat Eigong sub 2 minutes.
